body: I just started the game. I’m given 3 options and the choice to type out what I want to do. When I try to type, the app exits. There are too many freaking dark romances. I want light, comedic, happy, no mafia, no wolf and no vampires and absolutely no brother’s best friend. Nothing too explicit. It’s fine it’s there, I have no problem with that but it’s just that that’s the only thing there is

title: Great app to bad about the spark packages and usage
body: This actually turned out to be a really great app and was really fun to play. However, after playing I noticed that the sparks that I purchased weren’t lasting as much as I wanted them to I purchased a 299 package and it gave me 1000 sparks to use I figured that would last me for a day or two didn’t last me more than an hour maybe less. It seems like if you speak with the main character and he go into detail it will use up to 64 sparks per conversation you write. That seems excessive even especially with the DND game I play it only uses one credit per conversation I write and I could write as long as I want and as detailed as I want. I have to really consider if I want to play this or not

title: Charges to chat
body: The story’s are great & I love that it has personas. However I’m so so tired of all these apps making you pay to chat. I mean at least it’s a monthly subscription & not a weekly. However I feel like it was enough when the subscription was just for better memory or special stuff. Now all these apps are forcing the memberships to talk & that’s lame. This would be a five star app. In my book if it was free to chat.

title: Es buena!!
body: Es una aplicación muy entretenida, con historias y personajes que quieras seguir conversando. Sin embargo, ahy que recocer que tiene aspectos que nesecitan mejorar. La cantidad de chispas que se nesecitan para enviar mensajes es demasiada elevada y tener que esperar 24 horas para conseguir más limita muchísimo la experiencia. Además, avanzar en las historias puede convertirse en algo lento, sería más excelente que ofrecieran más oportunidades de conseguir más chispas gratis y que permitieran conversar con más libertad. Espero que me escuches lo más rápido posible!!!
